Initial release of jisu-bazi skill.

- Provides 八字排盘 (Bazi calculation) using Jisu Data API based on date, time, city, and gender.
- Returns ba zi, 乾/坤造, 纳音, 大运, 流年, and more key 八字 astrology info.
- Requires JISU_API_KEY environment variable for API access.
- Includes detailed usage instructions, parameter descriptions, and error handling.
- Intended for entertainment and educational purposes only.
